questions.question: What is the fundamental definition of a deadlock?
questions.gold_answer: A deadlock occurs when two or more processes are waiting for an event to happen, but that event will never occur, leaving the processes in a stuck state.
questions.quote: If two and more processes are waiting on happening of some event, but that event doesn't happen, that is called the deadlock.
questions.question_hi: deadlock ka basic definition kya hota hai?

questions.question: What are the four necessary conditions for a deadlock to occur?
questions.gold_answer: The four necessary conditions for a deadlock are mutual exclusion, no preemption, hold and wait, and circular wait.
questions.quote: The conditions are mutual exclusion, no preemption, hold and wait, and circular wait.
questions.question_hi: deadlock hone ke liye wo chaar necessary conditions kya hain?

questions.question: What does the mutual exclusion condition imply for resources?
questions.gold_answer: Mutual exclusion means that resources must be used by processes one at a time, and interleaving of resource usage is not allowed.
questions.quote: Mutual exclusion is ki whatever the resources you are using, all the resources must be used by all the processes in a mutual exclusive manner. Means one by one.
questions.question_hi: mutual exclusion condition ka resources ke liye kya matlab hai?

questions.question: How does the 'no preemption' condition contribute to a deadlock?
questions.gold_answer: No preemption means that a process cannot be forced to release a resource it is holding; it must hold the resource until it finishes its execution.
questions.quote: Ek process jo hold karke baitha hai, wo hold hi karega jab tak ki wo execute nahi hota, wo preempt nahi hoga, matlab uski switching wahan pe nahi hogi.
questions.question_hi: no preemption condition deadlock mein kaise contribute karta hai?

questions.question: What is the 'hold and wait' condition?
questions.gold_answer: Hold and wait occurs when a process is currently holding at least one resource while simultaneously waiting to acquire additional resources that are currently held by other processes.
questions.quote: Hold and wait means P1 is holding one resource that is R1 and waiting for R2. And P2 is holding one resource that is R2 and waiting for R1.
questions.question_hi: hold and wait condition kya hota hai?

questions.question: What is meant by a 'circular wait' in the context of deadlocks?
questions.gold_answer: Circular wait occurs when there is a closed loop of processes where each process is waiting for a resource held by the next process in the chain.
questions.quote: Circular wait means this is what a kind of circle, circle, this. This is what a kind of circle. Circle means like there is a loop in this.
questions.question_hi: deadlock ke context mein circular wait ka kya matlab hai?

questions.question: Why is it important for all four conditions to be present for a deadlock?
questions.gold_answer: A deadlock only occurs if all four necessary conditions are met simultaneously; if any one of them is absent, a deadlock might not occur.
questions.quote: Agar inmein se charon mein se koi bhi condition true nahi hoti, to there will be a chance ki deadlock occur na ho.
questions.question_hi: deadlock ke liye chaaro conditions ka hona kyun zaroori hai?

questions.question: Can a system be in a deadlock if only one or two of the necessary conditions are met?
questions.gold_answer: No, all four conditions are necessary for a deadlock to exist, so having only one or two is insufficient to cause a deadlock.
questions.quote: Inko hum bolte hain necessary and sufficient conditions to become a deadlock situation. To akeli ek situation nahi, mutual exclusion, no preemption, hold and wait, circular wait agar charon necessary conditions hain, then we can say deadlock occur ho raha hai.

questions.question: Is it true that a deadlock is guaranteed to occur whenever two processes are waiting for resources?
questions.gold_answer: No, a deadlock is not guaranteed just because processes are waiting; all four necessary conditions, including circular wait, must be met.
questions.quote: Agar inmein se charon mein se koi bhi condition true nahi hoti, to there will be a chance ki deadlock occur na ho.
